Alchemy Metal alpha 2 contains the projector-volume culling checkpoint from
`3bd0451efc` plus its recorded performance evidence from `092a648f79`.

Measured on the physical M1 Max acceptance host, projector GPU-channel time
fell 78.9% in the main world and 86.7% in mirror/hero rendering. The settled
quality-preset results were 76.4 FPS Low, 41.7 FPS Mid, 16.3 FPS High, and
7.1 FPS Ultra. Release 68512 passed 52,796 Metal assertions, deep code-sign
verification, and 349/349 ARM64 Mach-O slice inspection.

This is an early, owner-directed Apple Silicon Metal prerelease, not a general
release or a claim that the product release gates are complete. Ultra remains
well short of the 24 FPS objective; atmospheric haze and base lighting are the
next measured bottlenecks. Strict source-level OpenGL removal, complete
feature/visual parity, prolonged stability, independent review, and the formal
quality-equivalent 300-frame comparison also remain open.

The download contains an ad-hoc-signed native ARM64 macOS application archive
and its SHA-256 checksum. It uses the open-source dependency set; no private
Alchemy registry components are included.
